option_relations.rationale: Frontotemporal Dementia (FTD) is a broader category that encompasses TBK1-associated FTD-ALS spectrum disorder.
Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis–Frontotemporal Dementia (ALS-FTD) is a broader category that encompasses TBK1-associated FTD-ALS spectrum disorder.
Frontotemporal lobar degeneration–motor neuron disease (FTLD-MND) is a broader category that encompasses TBK1-associated FTD-ALS spectrum disorder.

The option 'Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis-frontotemporal dementia (ALS-FTD) spectrum disorder (TBK1-related)' is clinically equivalent to the leaf 'TBK1-associated frontotemporal dementia-amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (FTD-ALS) spectrum'.
